title: Erasing the final buffer cell
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and bit $b$, changing the buffer tape that stores $w$ followed by $b$ to blank at cell $|w|$ gives exactly the buffer tape that stores $w$.
replaced:
Blanking the cell at position $\abs{w}$ of the tape holding the buffered word
$w b$ (for any final bit $b$) yields exactly the tape holding the buffered
word $w$.
